decisions.reason: Adding hover animations to gallery items does not change the required category tabs or optional other-photography area.
The hover-animation change concerns gallery items and does not alter the homepage hero overlay or image-emphasis rules.
Hover animation is a separate presentation behavior and does not change the gallery's required scrolling or interactive browsing behavior.
The gallery hover-animation decision does not change homepage navigation to detailed pricing information.
Hover animations for gallery items do not alter the display, selection, or pricing-transparency requirements for individual services.
The gallery animation change does not affect the one-time pricing model or visibility of monthly and annual pricing tabs.
Hover animations for gallery items do not change the number or presentation of package-pricing boxes.
The source separately requests representative service images, but the hover-animation decision does not change the content or correspondence of those images.
Gallery-item hover behavior does not modify the independently stated site-wide requirement for a highly visual, image-focused presentation.
The gallery hover-animation change is unrelated to the deferred quote calculator's inputs, pricing logic, output, scope, or lifecycle.
